reasoning: Kanze-ryū Utaibon vol. 18 is one volume of a 20+ volume libretto series — a multi-work container holding several Noh play chant-texts per volume. The 'first English translation' claim is structurally ill-posed for a fragmentary school libretto volume. Furthermore, the individual Noh plays within such volumes have extensive prior English translation histories (Waley 1922, Keene 1970, Tyler 1992, Brazell 1998). No English translation of the Kanze-ryū Utaibon series as volumes exists.
